class.name: Axle
class.brief_description: Axle grouping node for exactly two vehicle wheels and an optional driven-wheel differential.
class.description: Axle groups its child [Wheel] nodes and stores steering, suspension/tire phase access, anti-roll force, and differential data. Vehicle setup requires exactly two distinct wheels and [TireData] on every axle. Positive [member drive_share] values identify driven axles; one through eight driven axles are supported and shares are normalized as flat weights with no inter-axle differential. Each driven axle is copied into a direct [code]DrivenAxle[/code] value with its two wheel bodies and [code]DifferentialSettings[/code] copied from [DifferentialData]. Open leaves relative motion unconstrained; Locked and Limited Slip construct transient left/right rows during the solve. Wheel rotational inertias may be unequal as long as each is finite and positive. A steering-rack resource is required only when [member is_steerable] is true.

method.name: set_steerable
method.description: Sets whether this axle responds to vehicle steering input.

method.name: get_steerable
method.description: Returns whether this axle is steerable.

method.name: set_drive_share
method.description: Sets the non-negative nominal drive share for this axle. Positive values mark the axle as driven.

method.name: get_drive_share
method.description: Returns this axle's nominal drive share.

method.name: set_differential_data
method.description: Sets the required axle differential resource for a driven axle.

method.name: set_steering_rack_data
method.description: Sets steering-rack parameters used when this axle is steerable.

method.name: set_tire_data
method.description: Sets tire parameters applied to this axle's wheels during setup.

method.name: set_downforce_ratio
method.description: Sets the fraction of aerodynamic downforce assigned to this axle, clamped to [0, 1].

method.name: get_downforce_ratio
method.description: Returns this axle's aerodynamic downforce fraction.

method.name: get_steer_angle
method.description: Returns the current steering angle in radians.
